faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Rohilkhand University Bareilly (MJPRU Bareilly) for a CST-UP sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Assistant (JRA) / Research Assistant (RA) under project ID 8303.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) / Research Assistant (RA) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for MJPRU Bareilly JRA/RA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by sending the filled application form and required documents via post or email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years as per the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for the JRA/RA post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 28,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on merit and specific requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to Dr. Deepak Gangwar, Principal Investigator, Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering, Faculty of Engineering & Technology, M.J.P. Rohilkhand University, Bareilly - 243006 (U.P.).
